name: Patient List for Tx Current 28 days MER Indicator Report

baseCohortDefinition.name: Active patients with up to 28 days LTFU

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND e.voided = 0 AND e.patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM (SELECT p.person_id AS patient_id, MAX(e.encounter_datetime) AS last_visit FROM encounter e INNER JOIN person p ON e.patient_id = p.person_id WHERE e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.voided = 0 AND p.voided = 0 GROUP BY p.person_id HAVING last_visit < DATE_SUB(:startDate, INTERVAL 28 DAY)) lost_patients)
